Fan marks 🔊🩹🌫️🖤🐳🐣 appear as decoration on guest titles; do not use

recommended_kind_model.unit: always from channel_id for these two channels
recommended_kind_model.primary: series owner if series_owner_tokens hit, else the single local member, else empty
recommended_kind_model.guests: every other identified member, same unit or not

kind.solo: primary set, no other local member except those listed as guests
kind.collab: two or more locals and no series owner, or explicit × of two locals without series
kind.unspecified: no person tokens, unit token present, not an obvious group/non_stream
kind.group: explicit unit collab/meeting/3-person wording without person tags
